item.title: US Should Return to Shuttle Diplomacy on Ukraine, Ex-White House Aide Believes
item.summary: WASHINGTON (Sputnik) - The United States should resume alternate negotiations with Moscow and Kiev to bring the two sides closer together on resolving the conflict in Ukraine, Thomas Graham, former Special Assistant to President George W. Bush and Senior Director for Russia on the National Security Council staff from 2004 to 2007, believes.
